Hello Sarmatt team,

For the PoE switches offered under the Sarmatt label with your DVRs and IP cameras, we build in your packaging from small lots: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $87.4 USD EXW with your logo (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget 8-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged - STC-028GP - $27.2; 16-PoE unmanaged on request. CE/RoHS files supplied; EAC stays on your side.

One question: which port count do your dealers order most - 4, 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
